title: A Horizon for the Vector
author: Coral Amberdale
blurb: Silas Vasquez, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, has spent seven years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
